subject: [PATCH v3 14/14] selftests/nfsd: check that listener removal asks rpcbind once

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to ensure that removing multiple listeners from the NFS daemon does not result in multiple timeouts for rpcbind. The test creates one listener, then three listeners while the stub is silent, and measures the number of calls made to rpcbind during each removal. It checks that the second and third removals do not reach rpcbind at all, thus preventing unnecessary timeouts.
